parameters.query:
INSERT INTO am_custom_fields (record_type, record_id, fields)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (record_type, record_id)
DO UPDATE SET fields = excluded.fields, synced_at = now()
RETURNING id, record_type, record_id;

meta.instructions: Preliminary work per Mike's 2026-08-07 request: reads and stores ApparelMagic's custom attribute fields (attN_*), which are genuinely dynamic -- the field NAME itself encodes whatever label someone configured in AM's UI, differs per endpoint, and isn't even consistent across endpoints for the same underlying concept (confirmed live 2026-08-10: orders/ has att1_customer+att2_purchase_order, purchase_orders/ has att1_customer+att2_sales_order, pick_tickets/ has att2__sales_order with a double underscore -- an AM-side quirk, not a typo here). Pulls Orders/Products/Purchase Orders/Pick Tickets/Customers in parallel, generically captures any attN_* key per record (regex match, not hardcoded field names -- see adapters/erp/apparelmagic/lib/extractCustomFields.js), skips records with none, and upserts into the new am_custom_fields table (core/supabase/migrations/0002_am_custom_fields.sql -- run this migration in Supabase before executing this flow) keyed on (record_type, record_id). Uses real $1/$2/$3 parameterized query (not the {{ }}-string-interpolation pattern used elsewhere in this repo) since these are arbitrary AM-side values, not our own generated keys. Not yet wired into canonical objects or any outbound EDI mapping -- this is read-and-store only, per Mike's literal request; how these fields eventually feed into 850/856/810/888/940/943 is a separate, later decision. Not scheduled -- manual trigger only until there's a reason to run it continuously. After import, re-select credentials: Query Auth account (all 5 Get AM * nodes), Postgres account (Upsert Custom Fields).
